summary.title: SecureNova AI Identity Security Threat MOdel
summary.description: SecureNova's AI-powered customer service platform uses Auth0 for identity management and an LLM agent to serve authenticated users. The AI agent accesses internal REST APIs, retrieves knowledge through a RAG pipeline, and invokes MCP server tools. The threat model identifies human and non-human identities, authentication mechanisms, privileges, data flows, trust boundaries, and security threats affecting the AI identity layer.

diagrams.title: SecureNova AI Identity Data Flow

data.name: Human user
data.description: Authenticated customer who accesses the AI customer service platform through Auth0 using OIDC and OAuth 2.0 with PKCE.

data.name: Auth0 Identity Provider
data.description: Auth0 authenticates human users using OIDC and OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with PKCE and issues tokens for authorized access.

data.name: AI Customer Service Agent
data.description: LLM-based AI agent that acts on behalf of authenticated users.

data.name: Internal REST APIs
data.description: Internal business APIs accessed by the AI agent using authorized OAuth scopes and short-lived credentials.

data.name: RAG Knowledge Pipeline
data.description: Retrieval-augmented generation service that retrieves knowledge from the internal knowledge base and supplies relevant context to the AI agent.

data.name: MCP Tool Server
data.description: Model Context Protocol server exposing authorized tools that the AI agent can invoke on behalf of authenticated users.

data.name: Knowledge Base
data.description: Internal knowledge repository used by the RAG pipeline. Retrieved content can influence AI agent behavior and therefore represents a prompt-injection and poisoning risk.

data.name: OAuth M2M Client
data.description: Machine-to-machine OAuth client identity used by the AI agent to obtain access tokens for protected APIs.

data.name: LLM API Key
data.description: Credential used to authenticate requests to the external LLM service. Exposure could allow unauthorized model usage or data access.

data.name: RAG Service Identity
data.description: Non-human service identity used by the RAG pipeline to authenticate to protected knowledge resources.

data.name: Authenticated AI Chat Request
data.description: The authenticated user sends the request to the AI service.

data.name: MCP Server Identity
data.description: Non-human service identity used to authenticate MCP tool-server interactions.

data.name: LLM Service
data.description: Large language model service processing user requests and retrieved context.

data.name: OAuth Access Token
data.description: The agent/application receives authorization information needed to access protected resources.

data.name: Bearer Token + API Request
data.description: The agent calls internal APIs using an authorized token.

data.name: RAG Knowledge Context
data.description: Retrieved knowledge returned from the RAG pipeline to the AI agent and incorporated into the model context.
